items.title: Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS to Limit Free Priority Pass Visits to 10
items.why: Lounge access caps are tightening; review lounge partner terms before pitching access benefits to issuers.
items.summary_ai: Mitsubishi UFJ NICOS will cap free Priority Pass lounge visits at 10 for its cardholders.
items.take: Lounge access caps are tightening; review lounge partner terms before pitching access benefits to issuers.
